# [Sky kit](https://omega.gg/Sky)
---

## Overview

This release integrates [qwindowkit](https://github.com/stdware/qwindowkit) into SkGui, refactoring
WAbstractView, WView, WViewDrag and WWindow to leverage native window management across platforms.
WUnzipper gains a new extractFile function, WControllerApplication fixes a typeIsAssociated
regression.


## SkCore

- WControllerFile: Update generateQml function.

- WUnzipper: Add extractFile function.

- WControllerApplication: Fix typeIsAssociated.


## SkGui

- WAbstractView: Integrate qwindowkit.

- WView: Update qwindowkit integration.

- WViewDrag: Update qwindowkit integration.

- WWindow: Update qwindowkit integration.


## SkyBase

- SkyWindow: Update qwindowkit integration.

- Style: Update qwindowkit integration.


## 3rdparty

- Add [qwindowkit](https://github.com/stdware/qwindowkit).

- Add turbopixel.

- Add hypergonar.

- Update tevolution.
